title: Separatedness of a separated scheme etale chart and its pullbacks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $U$ be a separated scheme. If $u:h_U	o E$ is a representable etale morphism, then $u$ is separated in the representable sense: its diagonal is a closed immersion after every scheme base change. For every scheme $C$ over $S$ with a morphism $c:C	o E$, the scheme fibre product $C	imes_EU	o C$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product].
